blocks.text: MALAYBALAY CITY, Bukidnon — A landmark tree that produced vibrant yellow blooms along the national highway each summer was uprooted Monday afternoon after heavy rains and strong winds from localized thunderstorms battered the city. Personnel from the Malaybalay City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO) responded to a distress call at around 2:55 p.m. about the fallen tree. The golden trumpet tree (Handroanthus chrysanthus) stood near Bukidnon National High School, the city’s largest public secondary school.
